//==
// # Magnitude, distance, and order-lattice interfaces
//
// The geometric half of the algebra vocabulary: length, distance, component-wise
// extrema and clamping, and the affine point/delta relationship.

// Has a notion of length or magnitude (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norm_(mathematics)).
// MagnitudeSquared avoids the square root when only relative comparisons are needed.
interface INormed
{
    Magnitude(x: Self): Number;
    MagnitudeSquared(x: Self): Number;
}
